item.title: EnvoyFilter Configuration in Istio
item.description: 1. What Is EnvoyFilter EnvoyFilter is a CRD resource in Istio that allows users to modify Envoy’s configuration to satisfy their customization needs for different scenarios. 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9 kubectl get envoyfilter -A NAMESPACE NAME AGE istio-system add-request-id-into-ingressgateway 54d istio-system compression-gzip 18d istio-system custom-access-log 3d istio-system ingressgateway-settings 52d istio-system preserve-request-header-us-test-ingress-gateway 95d istio-system preserve-x-request-id 54d When using Istio, you will usually end up using at least a few EnvoyFilters.
